PortfolioDocument.title: PortfolioDocument
PortfolioDocument.description: Published portfolio configuration document managed exclusively by the verified portfolio owner (petrosgeto7@gmail.com) and read by public visitors.

SITE_PROFILE.description: Core portfolio identity, hero text, portrait URL, metrics, and public contact links.

SOCIAL_LINKS.description: Public social and contact channel entries (maximum 16 items).

PHILOSOPHY_PILLARS.description: Engineering philosophy statements shown on the About page (maximum 12 items).

TECHNICAL_INTERESTS.description: Areas of technical focus shown on the About page (maximum 16 items).

EXPERIENCES.description: Work, training, and academic experience timeline entries (maximum 25 items).

PROJECT_CATEGORIES.description: Filter categories for the Work gallery (maximum 10 items).

PROJECTS.description: Case studies and software projects shown on Home, Work, and /work/[slug] (maximum 40 items).

BLOG_SETTINGS.description: Telegram blog channel username and editorial subtitle.

THEME_TOKENS.description: Optional Light and Dark UI color override tokens managed in Admin Appearance.

SEO_SETTINGS.description: Optional search engine metadata, OpenGraph image, and keyword settings.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin who saved the document.

updatedByEmail.description: Verified email address of the admin owner.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp set when the portfolio document is first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every admin save.

/portfolio/{docId}.description: Single published portfolio document at /portfolio/published. Public get access on 'published'; create, update, and delete restricted strictly to verified Google account petrosgeto7@gmail.com.
